items.name: Weddings
items.cardText: Your day, from getting ready to the last dance.

cardPhoto.alt: Bride in a lace-back gown beside a groom in a white dinner jacket on a porch

items.title: From getting ready to the last dance.
items.description: While your photographer handles the portraits, I'm catching everything around them: the buttons and the bustle, the happy tears, your friends losing it on the dance floor. Candid, behind-the-scenes content that shows what your wedding felt like, curated so it's ready to relive and share.
receives: Candid coverage of your day, captured on iPhone, with extra hours available if your day runs long.
An optional planning consultation before the wedding, so I know the moments and people that matter most.
Full access to all of your raw, unedited content.
A highlight recap reel plus short reels, set to your preferred trending audio.

sectionPhoto.alt: Bride in a lace-back gown beside a groom in a white dinner jacket on a porch

items.name: Bachelorette Weekends
items.cardText: The outfits, the chaos, the inside jokes and everything in between.

cardPhoto.alt: Bride in a high-neck lace gown standing with her father by a tall window

items.title: The outfits, the chaos, the inside jokes.
items.description: Bachelorette weekends move fast, and nobody wants to spend the trip behind a phone. I capture the getting ready, the matching outfits, the dinners, the dancing, and whatever happens after, so the whole crew can stay in the moment.
receives: Coverage of the full weekend, a single day, or just the events you choose.
Coverage in Georgia or wherever the trip takes you.
A curated collection of the trip's best photos and clips, made for the group chat and the feed.

sectionPhoto.alt: Floral heels and white wide-leg pants

items.name: Bridal Events
items.cardText: Showers, engagement parties, rehearsal dinners & more.

cardPhoto.alt: Round table set with green glassware, woven placemats, menus, and a white and green floral centerpiece

items.title: Showers, engagement parties, rehearsal dinners & more.
items.description: The celebrations before the wedding deserve their own spotlight. I capture the details you planned, the toasts, and the people who showed up for you, so these moments don't get lost in the lead-up to the big day. Planning a proposal or an engagement shoot? I capture those too.
receives: A curated collection of photos and videos from your event, focused on the details, the toasts, and your people.

sectionPhoto.alt: Round table set with green glassware, woven placemats, menus, and a white and green floral centerpiece

items.name: Celebrations
items.cardText: Birthdays, trips, milestones and all the moments worth documenting.

cardPhoto.alt: Nat in a striped knit set filming on her phone with a handheld grip

items.title: Birthdays, trips, milestones, and everything worth documenting.
items.description: Not every big moment comes with a veil. Milestone birthdays, trips with your favorite people, and the moments in between. Weddings and bridal celebrations are my focus, but if you're celebrating something worth remembering, tell me about it.
receives: A curated collection of candid photos and videos from your celebration.
